boundaries.name: keccak-hash
boundaries.obligation: `hash_words` and `builder.keccak256` are opaque callbacks (`HashEnvironment.hashWords`, `KeccakGadget`). Collision resistance, gadget soundness and native/gadget agreement are not stated; digest binding is proved only on a concrete compared pair with collision-freedom of that pair as a premise.

boundaries.name: enclosing-circuit-connects
boundaries.obligation: `channel_id` and `tx_tree_root` must be the enclosing circuit's block-level, already range-checked wires; the model takes them as parameters and their u32 bound as a premise. Whether any circuit still consumes this digest is outside the file (the source says it is not a live authorization path).

boundaries.name: plonky2-range-check-lowering
boundaries.obligation: `range_check(t, 32)` is the assumed predicate `SmallTargetRangeGates` on the witnessed wires; its gate/field lowering is unproved and it does not cover the caller's wires.

boundaries.name: native-and-target-representation
boundaries.obligation: Nat stands for u32 / u64 / Goldilocks field elements and `Wire := Nat` for `Target`; `assign : Wire -> Nat` is an arbitrary witness. Overflow, canonical field encoding and witness-write failures are not modeled.

boundaries.name: no-authorization
boundaries.obligation: No signature, member-slot registration, `tx_tree_root != 0`, block acceptance or the off-circuit `state_commitment_root == balance_state.h1()` check is modeled; the IMSB digest authorizes nothing in this module.
